description: This file declares the 'LocalStore' class, implementing the 'ILocalStore' interface for managing local database storage using SQLite in the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes method declarations for database operations such as opening the database, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, and managing entries within a local SQLite database. The class encapsulates a database connection and a storage path.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: Implements local database storage operations as specified by the ILocalStore interface, using SQLite3.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the database located at the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a database table with the given name.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of entries in the specified table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries in a table, starting from 'start' up to 'maxCount'.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries from a table starting at 'start' with 'count' entries.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries from the table within the specified range (start to end).

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds an entry to the specified table.
